entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling because I need to return an item. I'm just so disappointed.

I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's the ClubFit jersey. It's just... the wrong size. I saved up for this, and when I finally tried it on, it was just way too tight across my shoulders. I feel terrible about it. I've been a loyal customer for a long time.
I understand, that's definitely frustrating when the fit isn't right. Let me pull up your order information. One moment... Okay, I see the order was delivered 19 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, I think so. I've just been so busy, I didn't get to it sooner. I was really hoping you could help. I really need the money back right now.

Of course. Let me just confirm our policy here... Yes, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process that for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or did you want to do an exchange for a larger size?
Oh, a full refund is possible? That's a huge relief! Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I'm happy we could get this sorted out for you. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply pack the jersey up, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
That's perfect. You've been incredibly helpful. Thank you.
My pleasure. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
